title: Sustainable leaching of mixed LIB waste cathode employing a deep eutectic solvent composed of L-proline and lactic acid
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11442-11457
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09345G, Paper
Open Access

Pratyasha Panda, Sujata Mishra
Pro:LA DES+30% H2O recovered 98.32% Li, 100% Co, 99.07% Ni, and 85.63% Fe under optimized conditions of temperature 353 K, leaching time 120 minutes, and stirring speed of 900 rpm, demonstrating its strong capability of for efficient metal dissolution.
